verdict.rationale: Context.dev documents large-scale asynchronous batch jobs that scrape up to 25K URLs or crawl up to 25,000 pages in the background with progress tracking (docs-3, docs-34). It also documents per-minute rate-limit headers for managing throughput (docs-18), which covers the core need of gathering data at scale. missing for 10: explicit documentation of concurrent session or job limits, details on parallelism within batches, and independent or hands-on corroboration of high-volume throughput.
